items.title: Verizon Yields 6.2%. Is This Dividend Stock a Trap or a Retirement Bargain?
items.summary: A yield this high usually means Wall Street smells a cut, and Verizon is carrying $166 billion in debt after the Frontier deal. Yet one cash flow number and a bold new strategy from the CEO complicate the bear case for income-hungry retirees.

items.title: Your Phone Bill Could Pay You Back: $90,000 in These 3 Dividend Stocks Yields $4,967 a Year
items.summary: Wireless service and nicotine pouches generate cash that flows straight to shareholders. But one of these three dividend payers has been frozen since 2022, and heavy debt shadows two of them. Which one deserves your money?

items.title: Verizon (VZ) Stock May Sit Below Fair Value After AI Network Expansion
items.summary: Verizon Communications stock has quietly put up a solid run over the past few years, which naturally raises a simple question for anyone looking at the ticker today. Is the current share price of US$45.69 still in line with what the company’s cash flows can support, or has sentiment moved ahead of the fundamentals? Over the past 3 years, Verizon Communications has returned 55.6%, so a lot of investor belief is already tied to how durable its cash generation proves to be. Fresh moves into AI...

items.title: Musk Says SpaceX Could Buy a Legacy Telco and Use Its Spectrum 10 Times Better
